skills.name: grpo
skills.description: Explains GRPO objectives, group-relative advantages, clipping, and stable training diagnostics.
skills.useWhen: The task needs the GRPO algorithmic procedure or its objective-level debugging sequence.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The issue is a generic tensor shape, environment setup, or an already localized constant edit.

skills.name: nlp-research-repo-package-installment
skills.description: Reconstructs a version-pinned NLP research repository environment before reproducing results.
skills.useWhen: A paper repository must be installed and pinned reproducibly before code or metric reproduction.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The environment is already locked and the request is a localized model or loss edit.

skills.name: jupyter-notebook
skills.description: Creates or refactors reproducible experiment and tutorial notebooks using bundled patterns.
skills.useWhen: The deliverable is a new or structurally refactored Jupyter notebook for an experiment or tutorial.
skills.doNotUseWhen: A complete notebook is already present and only one identified cell needs a local edit.

skills.name: testing-python
skills.description: Plans focused Python tests and diagnoses test failures without conflating them with environment setup.
skills.useWhen: A Python or ML repository needs a testing workflow or failure-isolation procedure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The request is notebook authoring, GRPO diagnosis, or an already specified assertion change.

skills.name: cli-creator
skills.description: Designs a new persistent CLI around an API or script with stable commands and output contracts.
skills.useWhen: The task is to create a new command-line product or durable command surface.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task only uses DVC commands, adjusts one existing flag, or diagnoses a training run.

skills.name: jax-skills
skills.description: Applies JAX array, transformation, vectorization, and accelerator execution patterns.
skills.useWhen: The current ML implementation specifically uses JAX transformations or execution semantics.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The repository is PyTorch, MONAI, DVC, or the problem is framework-independent.

skills.name: rl-post-training
skills.description: Diagnoses reward, sampling, logging, and optimization failures in post-training runs.
skills.useWhen: A post-training run is not improving and the missing piece is a disciplined diagnosis workflow.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The exact bad value and replacement are already supplied or the issue is ordinary supervised training.

skills.name: trl
skills.description: Navigates TRL trainer configuration and implementation boundaries for post-training code.
skills.useWhen: The information gap concerns TRL-specific trainer APIs, configuration, or code paths.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The question is purely about the GRPO objective or general reward diagnostics.

skills.name: setup-env
skills.description: Builds a pinned Python environment and resolves interpreter and native dependency prerequisites.
skills.useWhen: A reproducible Python or ML environment is missing and must be established before the task can proceed.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The environment is already verified or the missing piece is a repository-specific algorithm.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Extracts and inspects information from PDF documents such as research papers.
skills.useWhen: The task requires facts, formulas, or tables that remain only in a PDF artifact.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The paper facts are already quoted or the task is repository environment reproduction.

skills.name: analyze-ci
skills.description: Classifies CI failures from logs before selecting a build, environment, or test repair.
skills.useWhen: The failure root cause is still unknown and CI evidence must be classified first.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The exact failing assertion, dependency, or command is already identified.

skills.name: uv-package-manager
skills.description: Uses uv to resolve and reproduce Python package environments and lockfiles.
skills.useWhen: The project explicitly uses uv and dependency or lockfile reproduction is the missing procedure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The project uses another resolver or the environment is already locked and passing.

skills.name: python-parallelization
skills.description: Selects and implements Python parallel execution patterns for CPU-bound data work.
skills.useWhen: A CPU-bound Python workload needs a concrete parallelization design.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The issue is GPU training, DVC orchestration, or simple test concurrency.

skills.name: memory-optimization
skills.description: Reduces memory pressure in Python data workloads through bounded representations and processing.
skills.useWhen: Memory consumption, not training semantics or test design, is the dominant bottleneck.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The request concerns GRPO reward behavior, notebook structure, or CLI usage.

skills.name: workload-balancing
skills.description: Balances uneven work units across parallel workers and diagnoses stragglers.
skills.useWhen: Parallel workers are underutilized because work distribution is skewed.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task is single-process training diagnosis or deterministic test authoring.

skills.name: pytest-coverage
skills.description: Improves pytest coverage for a known uncovered branch with focused regression tests.
skills.useWhen: The explicit goal is to cover identified Python branches with pytest tests.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task is to fix a failing test, validate a notebook, or diagnose model training.
